saints.name: St. Pius of Pietrelcina
saints.title: Priest
saints.shortBlurb: The Capuchin friar known to the world as Padre Pio, who bore the wounds of Christ and spent his days in the confessional…
biography: Born Francesco Forgione at Pietrelcina in 1887, he took the Capuchin habit and the name Pio and was ordained a priest in 1910. From 1918 he bore the visible stigmata — the wounds of the crucified Christ — which he carried for half a century at the friary of San Giovanni Rotondo.

For decades he heard confessions many hours a day, drawing pilgrims from across the world, and founded a great hospital, the "Home for the Relief of Suffering." Investigated and for a time restricted by Church authorities, he bore it in obedience. He died in 1968 and was canonized by Pope John Paul II in 2002.
saints.knownFor: The stigmata he bore and his long ministry of confession and healing.

sources.text: Vatican biography, Canonization of St. Pius of Pietrelcina (vatican.va)
